medicine.metaDescription: Medicine program, duration, qualification, leadership, and departments.
medicine.title: General
medicine.description: The university trains physicians in General Medicine in line with national standards, NQF educational requirements, and programs approved by the Academic Council.

paragraphs: The Faculty of Medicine was founded in 1991 under Dean A. Karapetyan. The General Medicine program was accredited by the Ministry of Education in 2001 and by the ANQA foundation in 2021 and 2024. Graduates receive a state diploma.
Training is aimed at physicians who can develop 21st-century medicine by integrating modern and traditional practice, with the knowledge and skills required by the healthcare labor market.
Alongside contemporary clinical subjects, the curriculum includes scientifically grounded traditional medicine: acupuncture, phytotherapy, homeopathy, manual therapy, and iridodiagnostics.
Studies take place in the main building, the Saribekyan University Medical Complex, and leading clinics in Yerevan. The program ends with a state final attestation.

Graduates may work in prevention and diagnosis, management, or research, and may continue in clinical residency or doctoral studies. Many practice, teach, or run private clinics in Armenia and abroad.
The university provides qualified faculty, simulation centers, laboratories, manikins and training equipment, and access to the library and electronic library.

dentistry.metaDescription: Dentistry program, duration, qualification, leadership, and department.
dentistry.title: Dentistry
dentistry.description: The university trains dentists in line with national standards, NQF educational requirements, and programs approved by the Academic Council.

paragraphs: The Faculty of Dentistry was founded in 1996 under Dean K. Vardanyan, Doctor of Medical Sciences, Professor. The Dentistry program was accredited by the Ministry of Education in 2001 and by the ANQA foundation in 2021 and 2024. Graduates receive a state diploma.
Training prepares dentists who can apply theoretical and practical knowledge in clinical work and meet the needs of the healthcare labor market.
Alongside contemporary medical subjects, the clinical part includes scientifically grounded traditional medicine: acupuncture and phytotherapy.

Studies take place in the main building, three new buildings including the Saribekyan University Dental Center and the Saribekyan University Medical Complex, and leading clinics in Yerevan. The program ends with a state final attestation.

Graduates may work in prevention and diagnosis, management, or research, and may continue in clinical residency or doctoral studies. Many practice in Armenia and abroad, and a number run their own clinics.
The university provides qualified faculty, simulation centers, laboratories, manikins and training equipment, and access to the university library and electronic library.

program.title: Academic program
program.description: Dentistry is a 5-year full-time program of 300 credits. The curriculum includes:

stomatology.title: Department of Stomatology
stomatology.description: Teaching of dental subjects, clinical practice, and professional skill development.

cpd.metaDescription: CPD programs: clinical training, medical education, assessment methods, and certification.
cpd.title: Continuing
cpd.description: Under the Vice-Rector for Quality Assurance and Educational Reform, the division runs qualification programs for clinicians, faculty, and health-system managers.

paragraphs: The Continuing Professional Development (CPD) division of Saribekyan International Medical University, under the direct supervision of the Vice-Rector for Quality Assurance and Educational Reform, delivers qualification programs for healthcare specialists, faculty, and health-system organizers.
The programs combine narrow clinical expertise with modern medical education, innovative teaching methods, and the full assessment system.

clinical.title: Clinical and specialty tracks
clinical.description: Healthcare professionals are offered credit-bearing CPD training, delivered with licensed centers, in the following formats.

evidence.title: Updated clinical courses
evidence.description: Evidence-based medicine protocols and international treatment guidelines.

simulation.title: Virtual and simulation practicums
simulation.description: Clinical and surgical skill practice on high-fidelity simulators.

masterclass.title: Interprofessional master classes
masterclass.description: Exchange with invited local and international experts and analysis of complex cases (case-based learning).

pedagogy.title: Medical education and teaching methods
pedagogy.description: This track is for university faculty, mentors of clinical residents, and physician-teachers.

groups.title: Interactive teaching methods
items: CBL and PBL: teaching built on challenging clinical situations.
Flipped classroom: independent study of theory on a digital platform, with class time used for discussion and problem solving.

groups.title: Simulation pedagogy and debriefing
items: Debriefing techniques after simulation that avoid creating stress for the learner.

groups.title: Digital and AI tools in medical education
items: Effective use of e-learning platforms (Moodle, Canvas).
Use of artificial intelligence tools to prepare learning materials and support independent student work.

assessment.title: Assessment systems and methodology
assessment.description: The course trains participants to apply objective, reliable, and internationally accepted assessment formats.

rows.description: International standard for assessing practical and clinical skills through stations.
How to write higher-order questions that test analytical and clinical reasoning.
Workplace-based observation and assessment of a student or resident’s clinical skills.
Giving feedback during learning so that the student can progress.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Short master classes (1–3 days) and longer training programs (1–6 weeks).

result.title: Outcome
result.description: Participants receive official CPD credits and certificates of national or international format.
